top_signals.title: CoreWeave’s Forecast Is Key to Stopping Another Earnings Selloff
top_signals.summary: CoreWeave Inc. shares have been on a roll lately after a monthslong slump. Now, the neocloud provider’s earnings after the close Tuesday can give investors a sense of whether the rally is sustainable.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
